name: Julio Cortázar
contribution: An Argentine and naturalised French novelist, short story writer, poet, essayist, and translator.
legacy: This person became notable for his numerous short stories, collected in such volumes as Bestiario, Final del juego, and Las armas secretas that established his reputation as a writer of short fiction.

checks.lead: Julio Florencio Cortázar (Latin American Spanish: [ˈxuljo koɾˈtasaɾ] ; 26 August 1914 – 12 February 1984) was an Argentine and naturalised French novelist, short story writer, poet, essayist, and translator. Known as one of the founders of the Latin American Boom, Cortázar influenced an entire generation of Spanish-speaking readers and writers in America and Europe.
